subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall report each feature's contract state as one of: drafting its first version; locked at version N; drafting version N+1 while version N binds; or still in the document pipeline.
fit_criterion: State queries over fixtures — a new draft, locked v1, a reopen while v1 binds, locked v2, and an unmigrated feature — return exactly those states.
